review_scope: 51 individually listed stranded members and three confirmed archives
method: Static source/control-flow analysis; Base64/Gzip/Deflate extraction; dnfile/dncil managed IL; rizin native disassembly and call references; no specimen executed. atomscan slow/local/no-update/no-follow and cleave facts saved per artifact.
context: Kali/Empire/DAVtest provenance makes authorized security testing plausible. Each listed member is a functional attack payload/module rather than documentation or an inert vendored library. Individual malicious verdicts follow credential harvesting, surveillance, exploitation or remote-control implementation, including the working test-directory Mimikatz. This does not prove unauthorized deployment. No operator authorization, victim configuration, runtime success or final remote payload is inferred. The macOS installer additionally has a configured collection endpoint and deceptive password/replacement/persistence paths.
count_method: Unique trait IDs across each member plus its decoded/extracted stages; archive counts are unique IDs across all archive units.
model_limit: Scans warn that v18 feature spec is older than expected v21. Model probabilities/FP levels are recorded without treating them as behavioral evidence.
rule_changes: Additive only: five hostile composites and five notable atomic observations in existing admitted leaves; no old matcher, scope, severity or rule was removed or weakened.
